headline: Fresh Strikes Reopen the Northern Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the map has grown busier at several of its most unsettled sectors. Kuura Strand has resumed heavy base turnover, recording ten events in the latest two hours and twelve in six, after a previously quiet spell; Menneen and Faden Point remain the chief names in the ledger. Weathered Expanse has likewise registered two fresh events, bringing its 24-hour total to 55, with Frostmarch, Spirit Watch, Crow’s Nest, and Wightwalk prominent amid very heavy casualties on both sides. Nevish Line has added three events in two hours and six in six, while casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating. Marban Hollow has also returned to action, with four recent events and 33 across the day, chiefly at Checkpoint Bua. Pari Peak’s 22 daily events include a fresh contest at 18:16 UTC. Olavis Wake remains active in the broader reckoning, with 22 events over 24 hours, though its latest recorded action is older. Farranac Coast and Gutter show earlier movement but have gone quiet in the latest window; several rear sectors remain largely undisturbed.
